svg.text: FORMAT LINEAGE: Tom Yeh, AI by Hand format
Is Your LLM Judge Really Agreeing With Humans? Compute Cohen's κ by Hand in Five Steps
AI-by-Hand style: ten traces, two graders (human and judge), one number that corrects for luck. 80% agreement sounds great until you see κ.
④ Agreement expected by pure chance
the judge is guessing — rewrite the rubric
add 5-10 worked examples to the judge prompt
usable for triage; keep a human on every FAIL
ship it; re-sample 50 traces per release
If 60% of traces pass anyway, two graders
flipping biased coins would agree ~52% of the
time. κ subtracts that luck, so 80% raw
Landis & Koch (1977) bands; recompute every release.
DO THIS WITH YOUR OWN JUDGE (20 MINUTES)
Pull 10-50 traces your team already labeled PASS/FAIL.
Run your judge, fill the four cells a, b, c, d.
Compute κ; if below 0.6, fix the rubric before trusting
Raw agreement flatters every judge; κ tells you how much of it was skill.
